Title: Construction Carpenters
Task: Install structures or fixtures, such as windows, frames, floorings, trim, or hardware, using carpenters' hand or power tools.

Title: Automotive Master Mechanics
Task: Install and repair accessories, such as radios, heaters, mirrors, and windshield wipers.

Title: Maintenance and Repair Workers, General
Task: Paint or repair roofs, windows, doors, floors, woodwork, plaster, drywall, or other parts of building structures.

Title: Locksmiths and Safe Repairers
Task: Install door hardware such as locks and closers.
